title: rbac v2: migrate policies + audit logging KMS region pinning
author: Priya Kapoor
description: This PR implements RBAC v2 policy schema, a safe migration path for existing RBAC v1 policies, audit logging enhancements to encrypt audit payloads with KMS, and region pinning controls so KMS keys and audit data can be constrained to customer-specified regions for data residency compliance. Motivation: several enterprise customers requested explicit region pinning + stronger audit immutability guarantees for GDPR/UK-GDPR and APAC data residency pilots; this also prepares us for upcoming SOC2/HIPAA controls. Work included: 1) new RBAC v2 JSON/YAML schema and validation in redwood/rbac; 2) a migration script that reads v1 policies and emits v2 equivalents with a dry-run option and reversible migration metadata; 3) audit logging pipeline changes to add envelope encryption using customer-region KMS keys and a new AuditLogKeyManager abstraction with region selection; 4) config and operator docs for region_pin settings in Private and Dedicated; 5) unit/integration tests and e2e Canary scenario updates; 6) documentation updates and a Linear task reference. The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, CI, review discussion, and rollout notes.

review_comments: Martin O'Malley (2026-02-12): Please clarify rollback story for partial migrations. What happens if a node fails mid-migration?

Priya Kapoor (2026-02-12): Migration writes reversible metadata and supports a safe rollback command. If a node fails mid-migration the operator can run the rollback which will use the recorded mapping to restore v1 entries; added tests for partial failure cases.
Sofia Martinez (2026-02-13): KMS integration looks good, can we ensure key rotation won't invalidate historic audit logs?

Priya Kapoor (2026-02-13): Added envelope encryption where we store the per-run DataKey wrapped by the customer KMS key. Rotation of the KMS key only requires re-wrapping the DataKey; historic logs remain decryptable with previously wrapped keys and our key-rotation tool documents the rewrap process.
Daniel Kim (2026-02-14): Add unit tests for cross-region failover where a region is disabled by policy; ensure we don't leak keys to other regions.

Priya Kapoor (2026-02-15): Added integration tests that simulate region disablement and verify AuditLogKeyManager returns an error if region_pin prevents key access. Also added a config validation warning in helm when region_pin is set but no KMS key is configured for that region.
Aisha Farah (security review) (2026-02-16): Approved after minor comments on docs wording for operator runbook.
release_notes: RBAC v2 policy schema and migration; audit log envelope encryption with KMS region pinning; operator docs and runbook for migration and key rotation; config flag 'region_pin' for Private/Dedicated deployments.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag rbac_v2_enabled=false by default. 2) Enable dry-run migration with operator to generate migration preview. 3) Run canary migration on staging and one customer Private deployment with customer consent. 4) Enable rbac_v2_enabled=true rollout window with monitoring and automatic rollback hook. 5) Post-migration run key rotation verification and audit replay checks.
operator_notes: Operators must provide a KMS key mapping per region when region_pin is used. The migration tool supports --dry-run and --rollback flags. Default behavior does not change existing v1 policies until operator explicitly runs migration. See docs/ops/rbac-migration-runbook.md for CLI examples and troubleshooting.
security_considerations: Audit payloads are envelope-encrypted using per-run DataKeys wrapped by customer-region KMS keys. We do not store plaintext DataKeys. The AuditLogKeyManager enforces region_pin at encryption time and throws on cross-region key access. Access logs include KMS key usage entries which are forwarded to the central audit pipeline.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for v2 schema validation, migration dry-run and rollback, KMS mocks for envelope encryption, and e2e canary that validates region_pin enforcement. CI initially hit a flaky canary test which was re-run and now passes. Integration tests cover partial-node failure during migration.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the old RBAC v1 code paths for read compatibility; a follow-up PR will remove v1 after a deprecation window and customer notification.
